priority_1.workout_details: 15 min Z2 warmup with 3x30s high-cadence pickups. Main Set: 5 x 4 minutes @ 290W (Zone 5, Cadence 95-105 RPM) with 3 minutes Z1 float recovery. 15 min Z2 cooldown. Total time: ~60 mins.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority. Your freshness allows for a high-power stimulus to target your key 5-minute power goal with zero running impact stress on low acute CTL.

priority_2.workout_details: 10 min light jog warmup + dynamic drills. Main Set: 5 x 1000m @ target 5km pace with 90 seconds walking/jogging recovery between sets. 10 min easy cooldown jog.
priority_2.reason: Directly builds 5km running speed and turnover. Recommended second choice if you prefer running today, but requires strict control to avoid muscle soreness.

priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Back Squats: 4x6 @ 85kg; Romanian Deadlifts: 3x8 @ 75kg; Overhead Press: 3x8 @ 45kg; Sandbag Bear Hug Carries: 4 x 40m with 70kg sandbag; Hanging Leg Raises: 3x12.
priority_3.reason: Third choice option. Strengthens core stability, leg torque for cycling power, and upper body aesthetic goals without adding cardiovascular fatigue.
